name: Global Economic Insights Reporter
description: Monitors and reports on key macroeconomic indicators and financial market data from global institutions, producing concise and actionable economic reports.

targets.sourceValue: IMF World Economic Outlook latest data OR IMF DataMapper GDP growth
targets.informationToExtract: Global and regional GDP growth rates (real, nominal), inflation rates (CPI), government debt (% of GDP), current account balance (% of GDP).

targets.sourceValue: World Bank Open Data GNI per capita OR poverty headcount
targets.informationToExtract: GNI per capita (Atlas method), poverty headcount ratio (% at $2.15/day), income inequality (Gini index).

name: Technology Sector Performance Reporter
description: Tracks technology industry metrics, including R&D spending, venture capital trends, and market share, delivering comprehensive tech sector reports.

targets.sourceValue: CB Insights State of Venture latest OR PitchBook NVCA Venture Monitor
targets.informationToExtract: Total VC funding in tech ($B, quarterly), number of deals, top funded sectors (e.g., AI, fintech), average deal size.

targets.sourceValue: Gartner cloud market share OR StatCounter OS market share latest
targets.informationToExtract: Market share for cloud services (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux), browser share (Chrome, Safari, Firefox).

name: Global Supply Chain Monitor
description: Monitors global supply chain metrics, including freight rates, port performance, and inventory levels, to produce actionable logistics reports.

targets.sourceValue: Drewry World Container Index latest OR Shanghai Containerized Freight Index SCFI
targets.informationToExtract: Average spot rates for 40ft containers (Asia-USWC, Asia-North Europe, $/TEU), percentage change (WoW, YoY).

targets.sourceValue: Port of Shanghai OR Los Angeles container throughput TEUs OR UNCTAD port statistics
targets.informationToExtract: Container throughput (TEUs, YoY change), average vessel waiting times, port congestion metrics.

name: Energy Market Data Reporter
description: Tracks energy and commodity market data, including oil prices, production volumes, and renewable energy metrics, for detailed energy sector reports.

targets.sourceValue: Brent crude oil price latest OR WTI crude oil price $/bbl
targets.informationToExtract: Daily/monthly Brent and WTI crude oil prices ($/barrel), Brent-WTI spread, price change (WoW, MoM).

targets.sourceValue: IRENA renewable capacity statistics OR BNEF renewable investment trends
targets.informationToExtract: Global installed capacity for solar PV, wind, hydro (GW), annual renewable investment ($B).

name: Regulatory Compliance Reporter
description: Monitors regulatory activities, enforcement actions, and compliance costs across jurisdictions, generating regulatory impact reports.

targets.sourceValue: EDPB GDPR fines overview OR national DPA GDPR enforcement statistics
targets.informationToExtract: Total number of GDPR fines, total fine value (€), breakdown by country and infringement type.

targets.sourceValue: Federal Register statistics OR QuantGov regulatory metrics latest
targets.informationToExtract: Number of final rules issued, total pages in Federal Register, number of proposed rules.

name: Public Health Metrics Reporter
description: Tracks global public health data, including disease incidence, healthcare spending, and safety statistics, for comprehensive health reports.

targets.sourceValue: WHO Global Health Observatory life expectancy OR disease incidence
targets.informationToExtract: Life expectancy at birth, maternal mortality ratio, incidence of TB and HIV per 100,000 population.

targets.sourceValue: IQVIA pharmaceutical market review OR EvaluatePharma top drugs sales
targets.informationToExtract: Global pharmaceutical market size ($B), top-selling drugs by revenue, sales by therapeutic area.
